main_body: Shrine building with copper-green tiled roof and red/white timber facade
top_band: Copper-green roof ridge and slope from rows 4 to 42 (with gold katsuogi at rows 0-3)
evidence: The structure clearly shows the large sloping top surface of the roof (rows 4-42) above the red lintel (rows 43-46) and vertical front wall/doors (rows 47-72) and stone base (rows 73-78). The lintel has a distinct lighter top edge at row 43, eave shadow beneath it at row 46-47, and inset central doors.

style.evidence: The candidate matches the Beodeul building references well: the roof has 6 distinct teal/green value steps with individually shaded tiles, the plaster walls have subtle speckle texture, the wooden beams and lattice doors have multiple brown/red shading steps, and outlines use dark material tones.
